tools.name: about_site
tools.description: Describes Broke It (brokeit.dev): its mission, topics, post count, feeds and podcast shows.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Lists the newest posts on brokeit.dev plus the newest episode of each podcast show, newest first. Optional topic filters posts by tag (episodes are omitted when a topic is given).

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Searches brokeit.dev posts and recent podcast stories. Every query word of 3+ letters must match; title hits score 3, tag hits 2, excerpt and body hits 1 per word.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Returns one brokeit.dev post with its metadata and full text, looked up by slug or by URL. Bodies over 100,000 characters are truncated with a note.

tools.name: list_shows
tools.description: Lists the podcast shows published on brokeit.dev with language, feed and page URLs and episode counts.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: Lists recent episodes of one podcast show, newest first, with title, duration, story count and audio URL.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Returns one podcast episode: the stories covered with their source links and summaries, the transcript, and the audio URL.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_news, get_post, list_shows, list_episodes, get_episode · Public sink: about_site, get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_news, get_post, list_shows, list_episodes, get_episode · Public sink: about_site, get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
